basis: Previous fixed30Train pixel probe measured body principal axes but tested box localization only. Negative box correction does not test whether current axes carry useful motion-heading information.
features: Reuse current-proposal RGB-gray and fixed DiffV2IR axes from the already measured same30Train frames. No new crop, model, image generation or tracker. Cached axes were measured before Train GT join.
targets: Train GT center displacement from t-lag to t for same ID; this is an oracle motion target for a feature diagnostic, not an available inference feature or tracking accuracy.
primary_metric: Mean doubled-angle dot product between axis and GT displacement, on same co-valid strict RGB-gray/IR proposals; equal-video IR-minus-gray.
controls: All co-valid proposals and strict same-frame cyclic orientation permutation. Report coverage for each; never choose a lag or reliability rule after outcome.
interpretation: Gate only decides whether to pursue proposal-based causal association diagnostics. Even aligned axes cannot establish identity discrimination, useful matching or HOTA gain.
